Cheaper than Opus, with physics just as good. Astra, is that really you? 😂🦑

Claude Opus 5.5 vs ChatGPT-6 Astra

Astra really surprised me this time. It finally came out cheaper, and the physics is on par with Opus. The squid squishes nicely, its tentacles sway and wrap around your finger. You just want to keep poking, stretching, and brushing it

Everything runs right in the browser on WebGPU: soft-body physics and fur you can comb. No premade models or textures

Estimated API cost:

Opus - $11.70
Astra - $9.94

Would you pick Astra this time? 👀
